title: GEsc
description: GEsc gives the pause and options menus a sleek dark-glass makeover with glowing cyan accents. Every button, slider, and checkbox is redesigned with smooth rounded edges and a modern neon glow. A simple visual upgrade for anyone tired of the default gray UI
body:
Tired of Minecraft's flat, gray pause screen? GEsc reimagines the vanilla UI with a sleek, dark glass-panel aesthetic and glowing cyan accents, giving your Escape menu and Options screens a modern, polished look — without touching gameplay, blocks, or textures anywhere else.
What's included:

Buttons — Redesigned with a dark navy glass finish, subtle inner sheen, and a soft cyan border. Hovering lights them up with a brighter glow, while disabled buttons fade into a muted gray glass style.
Sliders — Volume, FOV, render distance, and every other slider now use a slim pill-shaped track with a glowing cyan-outlined handle instead of the old blocky bar.
Checkboxes — Toggle options get a clean rounded box with a crisp cyan checkmark when enabled, plus matching hover states.
Pack Icon — A custom-branded icon to match the theme.

Compatibility:
Built and tested for Minecraft 1.21.4. Since it only replaces GUI sprite textures, it's lightweight, has zero performance impact, and works alongside any texture pack that doesn't already override GUI widgets.
Installation:
Drop the .zip file directly into your resourcepacks folder (no need to extract it) and enable it from Options → Resource Packs.
